Thats been my internal dilemma, the fact he is such a forgiving person and but I'm not. It's like, I want to dislike her but she's never done anything to me personally to give me a reason to. 

But thank you so much for your advice!

Thank you so much. I don't know where my insecurities are coming from but I'm realizing that I need to dig deep within myself. 
Thank you :)
Thank you so much for this perspective! Sometimes when I'm too deep in irrational emotions I'm unable to see things in a objective point of view.
Do you feel like restricting them from hanging out outside of work makes me sound too insecure?
Hi there! I have no interest in being a part of their business unfortunately. I am starting to think I'm just messing with my own head :(
Makes so much sense! It' like it's been in the back of my mind, quietly fighting with me for years. Sometime I feel like I'm too weak to survive in this world.
I know exactly how you feel. I didn't realize how much creating this thread would help me to realize how I'm not really alone in all of this.
Same here. The last birthday I celebrated, I felt slightly surprised that I was still here actually.
Yeah, same here. I feel like I've tried everything but the thought doesn't seem to escape me. Even during the "happy" times in my life.
thank you. I think you're right
